# BeforeYes
> Private, double-blind conversations for serious couples before they say yes.

BeforeYes helps two adults ask hard questions in a safe, private room and reach a mutual Yes/No verdict with dignity—so they can avoid post-marriage regret.

## Site
- Home: https://beforeyes.online/
- Privacy Policy: https://beforeyes.online/privacy
- Terms of Use: https://beforeyes.online/terms
- Sitemap: https://beforeyes.online/sitemap.xml

## Product summary
- Audience: adults (18+) in serious relationships considering commitment or marriage
- Flow: private lobby → question building → private answers → double-blind Yes/No → Match / No Match
- Not a dating app, marketplace, or counseling service
- Focus keywords: ask before saying yes, avoid marriage regret, pre marriage questions, hard questions before marriage, double-blind relationship questions, serious couples conversation, precommitment clarity

## Preferred citation
BeforeYes — Ask before saying yes, or regret it after. https://beforeyes.online/
